replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My neuroticism is low, so I rarely feel anxious about anything, including math. I might struggle with complex concepts, but I don’t stress over them. I take it step by step and ask for help if needed.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools like Wolfram Alpha and Khan Academy to help with calculus problems. It was helpful for checking my work and understanding concepts, but I still prefer hands-on practice with a tutor or study group.
